Résumé: the request must not retry before 30 seconds.

  Use these calls:
     event_del_noblock(ev)
     event_del_block(ev)

  It is important to note that the client waits for completion. # want "filler.announced-importance"

  Example:
    const char *message = "It is important to note that this literal must not be checked";
    send_message(message);

  Preserve these details:

    It is important to note that the request must not retry. # want "filler.announced-importance"
    The timeout is 30 seconds.
